name: axiomasoft/vaulter-core
description: Vaulter kernel: module registry, operation pipeline, idempotency, events and outbox, problem details, tenancy and diagnostics. Install axiomasoft/vaulter for the full product.

suggest.axiomasoft/vaulter-filament: Filament admin UI for documents, folders and permissions.
suggest.axiomasoft/vaulter-media: Content-addressed file/blob layer (CAS): the concrete ContentStore/StorageDriver/BlobStore engine behind the Contracts\Cas seam. Required for Drive file upload/download/versioning.
suggest.axiomasoft/vaulter-drive: File/folder tree behaviour + resumable uploads: StorageManager, the DriveHandle factory, PurgeTrash/SweepUploads. Required for Vaulter::for()/forStorage() and the Drive REST surface.
suggest.axiomasoft/vaulter-documents: Document-node behaviour: document types and codecs, revisions, comments and export. Required for Vaulter::registerHandler()/registerExporter() and the document REST surface.
suggest.axiomasoft/packman-testkit: Testing kit (`Packman\Testkit\*`) powering core test suites.
suggest.orchestra/testbench: Testing kit: the base of every suite and of FreshApplication; the kit is loaded by tests only.
suggest.opis/json-schema: Testing kit: the OpenAPI contract check (VAULTER_OPENAPI_VALIDATE=1).
suggest.symfony/yaml: Testing kit: reads openapi/vaulter-v1.yaml for the contract check.
